fun_facts: Deebo Samuel was born in Inman, South Carolina.
His father gave Deebo Samuel the nickname “Deebo” after the bully in the movie Friday because, as a toddler, he was always taking things from people.
In high school, Deebo Samuel also got the nickname “Sweet Feet” from his stepmother because of his speed.
At Chapman High, Deebo Samuel set a school record with 53 career touchdowns and totaled 3,649 yards.
At South Carolina, Deebo Samuel finished his college career with a school-record four kickoff-return touchdowns, tied for the SEC record.
In a playoff game against Dallas, Deebo Samuel set the Super Bowl-era record for most rushing yards by a primary receiver, with 72.
